patch_description: A causal robust local-linear trend filter combining the efficient vectorized moving-average baseline with an endpoint-aligned Huber regression and adaptive alpha-beta tracker. The filter uses innovation clipping, short/long trend agreement, dead-band velocity suppression, and two-sample confirmation for weak reversals. This reduces noise-driven slope flips while retaining fast response to sustained non-stationary changes. Inputs, public functions, output lengths, and result dictionary formats are preserved.
